body.statement: For \(N=4\), determine a nonempty two-dimensional parameter cell \(J\), an explicit optimizing channel family, and an attaining certificate \(\Gamma_J\) for which one algebraically isolated endpoint lies on the boundary of \(\mathcal B_{4,\alpha}\); prove the sign of \(\Delta_{4,\alpha}(\lambda)\) on both adjacent cells and identify which channel support or confidence active set changes at that endpoint.
body.justification: An actual optimizer-attaining cell and sign-certified endpoint are the nonroutine content that separates a structural design theorem from a high-precision numerical bracket.
body.gap: No cited work identifies a boundary for a common-channel, exact finite-population causal confidence game; the presolve evidence establishes only exclusion and a narrow value bracket near \(\lambda=1000\).
body.consumer: The endpoint yields an operational rule for when a one-bit hidden-assignment reporting protocol ceases to be minimax and a richer local report must be deployed.

obligation.what_is_open: Produce a nonempty two-dimensional cell \(J\) on which a specified balanced binary family and an unrestricted global lower certificate attain the same value, then exhibit an adjacent cell with a strict sign for \(\Delta_{4,\alpha}(\lambda)\).
obligation.obstruction: The verified simultaneous tensor certificate at \((\lambda,\alpha)=(1000,2/5)\) has a nonzero gap of \(297/50000000\), and that point lies in a certified nonbinary exclusion interval. Membership in \(\mathcal B_{4,\alpha}\) does not itself yield the simultaneous confidence-dual saddle required for an attaining \(\Gamma_J\).
obligation.attempted: Exact fixed-channel primal--dual extraction, all fourteen staircase weights, complete enumeration of \(41^4=2825761\) polarized vertex tensors, robust dual refinement at \(\lambda=1000\), and reuse of binary-optimal duals at \(\lambda=2,3,10,100\). The latter duals left visible global relaxation gaps, so no active set could be continued with equality.
obligation.partial_result: The exact computations prove \(129113957/50000000\le L^\star_{4,2/5}(1000)\le64557127/25000000\), force \(m=2\) at \(\lambda=1000\), prove \([999.9,1000.1]\cap\mathcal B_{4,2/5}=\varnothing\), and reduce every certified boundary to the finite polynomial contacts in the narrowed certificate theorem.  They do not give equality in the global lower certificate at a specified optimizing channel or any nonempty equality cell.
